title: Delta Cassidy Roman Tub Faucet Trim, Chrome (T2797-LHP)

comparisons.notes: Same model T2797-LHP chrome trim kit, UPC 034449681551

writeup: Delta's Cassidy deck-mount Roman tub faucet in chrome is $148.99 new on Woot, while Home Depot and Lowe's both charge $299 for the same T2797-LHP trim. Heads up: it's the trim kit only, so the R2707 rough-in valve and a Cassidy handle kit are sold separately. Delta backs it with a lifetime limited warranty.
